service.description: What a party (the current user's by default) may do with a contact list. For a mailbox: canSeeHeader (its name and description: public, a help mailbox, a member or a pending request), canReadAll (every thread: a member, or any user of a public mailbox that is not a help mailbox), canReadOwn (the threads the party takes part in: canReadAll, or anyone on a help mailbox), canPost (by the posting policy, not when archived), canModerate (an owner or moderator), canJoin. A list of another type can be seen and posted to (while not archived) and has no member reading. contactList is null when the party may not see it. Another party's access to a mailbox is told only to a user who may see the mailbox's header; otherwise it is as for a party outside a private mailbox.

parameter.name: partyId
parameter.description: Defaults to the current user's party

parameter.name: postingEnumId
parameter.description: ClpMembers when the list has none

parameter.name: membershipStatusId
parameter.description: The party's current row's status: CLPT_ACCEPTED, CLPT_PENDING, CLPT_REJECTED

parameter.name: deliveryEnumId
parameter.description: A member's delivery: the row's, else the list's default, else CldInbox

service.description: The mailboxes a party (the current user's by default) may read every thread of (a member, or a public mailbox that is not a help mailbox), and the others, whose posts the party sees only when from, to or a recipient of them. For limits such as the universal search's.

parameter.name: partyId
parameter.description: Defaults to the current user's party

service.description: A contact list. The current user's party becomes its owner (a current CLPT_ACCEPTED row with role ListOwner), and memberPartyIdList its first members. A mailbox (type MAILBOX) needs a user with a party, is private unless isPublic=Y, and its posting policy defaults to ClpMembers and its default delivery to CldInbox.

parameter.name: ownerPartyId
parameter.description: The organization the list belongs to

service.description: Changes a contact list; a field left out (null) is not changed. archived=true archives it (read-only: no posts or members), false restores it. A mailbox is changed only by its owners.

The contact lists of a type (contactListTypeEnumId, such as MAILBOX) the current user may see, by name: for mailboxes the public ones, the help mailboxes and the private ones the user is a member of or asked to join. Each has the user's membership (isMember, membershipStatusId, memberRoleTypeId, deliveryEnumId), what the user may do (canPost, canModerate, canJoin), memberCount, and for a mailbox the user may read lastPostDate and unreadCount (the user's unread rows on its posts, not archived). memberOnly limits to the lists the user is a member of or asked to join; archived lists are left out unless includeArchived.

parameter.name: searchText
parameter.description: Part of the name or description

service.description: The members of a contact list (current CLPT_ACCEPTED rows) with their name, role, delivery (deliveryEnumId as set, effectiveDeliveryEnumId with the list's default) and since when, owners first. pendingList has the join requests (CLPT_PENDING), for the mailbox's owners and moderators. A mailbox's members are seen by those who may read it, and a public one's by any user.

The current user joins a contact list: a member (CLPT_ACCEPTED) of a public list, a join request (CLPT_PENDING) for a private one, which an owner or moderator accepts with add#ContactListParty or declines with decline#ContactListParty. A private mailbox is not shown to those outside it, so a request goes by its id (a link or an invitation); the requester then sees its header. A member or a pending request stays as it is; a declined request may be asked again.
The current user leaves a contact list, or withdraws a join request: thruDate on the current rows. The last owner of a mailbox cannot leave while it has other members.

actions.script: left = false const partyId = ec.user.userAccount?.partyId || null if (!partyId) { ec.message.addError('Leaving a list needs a user with a party'); return } ec.service.sync().name('mantle.marketing.ContactListServices.end#ContactListParty') .parameters({contactListId: contactListId, partyId: partyId}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return left = true

service.description: Sets thruDate on a party's current rows of a list (internal: leave#ContactList and remove#ContactListParty check who may). The last owner of a mailbox is not removed while the mailbox has other members.

parameter.name: roleTypeId
parameter.description: ListOwner, ListModerator, or empty for a member

service.description: An owner or moderator of a mailbox removes a member or withdraws an invitation (thruDate); a moderator does not remove an owner. The last owner is not removed while the mailbox has other members.
An owner or moderator of a mailbox declines a party's pending join request (CLPT_REJECTED).

A member's delivery of a mailbox's posts: CldInbox (in the Inbox and its count) or CldMailboxOnly (only under the mailbox); empty goes back to the list's default. The current user sets their own; an owner or moderator may set another member's.

parameter.name: partyId
parameter.description: Defaults to the current user's party
